keyMappings:
# Scroll
unmap u
map e scrollPageUp
map E scrollFullPageUp
map D scrollFullPageDown

# Tabs
unmap J
unmap K
unmap <<
unmap >>
map <c-j> previousTab
map <c-k> nextTab
map <c-J> moveTabLeft
map <c-K> moveTabRight

# hints
unmap f
unmap F
map F LinkHints.activateMode
map f LinkHints.activateModeToOpenInNewTab

# History
unmap o
unmap O
map O Vomnibar.activate
map o Vomnibar.activateInNewTab

# Bookmarks
unmap b
unmap B
map B Vomnibar.activateBookmarks
map b Vomnibar.activateBookmarksInNewTab

# Open url
unmap p
unmap P
map P openCopiedUrlInCurrentTab
map p openCopiedUrlInNewTab

# Edit URL
unmap ge
unmap gE
map <a-e> Vomnibar.activateEditUrl
map <a-E> Vomnibar.activateEditUrlInNewTab

# Focus Input
unmap i
unmap gi
map i focusInput
